title: Your First Program
summary: Combine everything to pass the Coding Foundations assessment.

steps.title: Bringing It All Together
steps.markdownContent: You now know about statements, variables, operators, if/else decisions, functions, loops, and the structure of an Arduino sketch.

quickCheck.question: How do software code and physical hardware components work together in a robot?
options: Code sends electrical signals through pins to command components
They do not interact at all
quickCheck.explanation: The microcontroller translates code commands into electrical voltages that power motors, lights, and sensors!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Your brain thinks raise hand, and your muscles move. Code is the thought, electronics are the muscles.

quickCheck.question: What are the two core functions found in every Arduino program?
quickCheck.explanation: Every Arduino program requires setup() to initialize hardware once, and loop() to repeat tasks continuously!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: First you wake up and get ready (setup), then you go about your active day (loop).

steps.title: Mentally Writing a Sketch
steps.markdownContent: Given a hardware goal, identify the necessary global variables, configure pins in `setup()`, and write the logic in `loop()`.

steps.title: Compilation Simulation
steps.markdownContent: Review how code goes from text to binary.

steps.title: Final Debugging
steps.markdownContent: One last bug hunt before the placement assessment.

steps.title: Placement Assessment
steps.markdownContent: Pass this 8-question assessment to complete Coding Foundations.

questions.question: What is a variable?
options: A named storage container in memory

questions.question: What is an `if` statement used for?
What does a function do?
options: Groups code into a reusable named block

questions.question: What is the purpose of a `for` loop?
options: To run code a specific number of times
questions.explanation: For loops repeat code for a counted number of iterations.

questions.question: When does the `setup()` function run?
options: Once, when the Arduino turns on
questions.explanation: Setup is for initialization at startup.

questions.question: What runs continuously on an Arduino?
If your code is missing a semicolon, what type of error is it?
questions.explanation: Missing punctuation is a syntax error.
